The output should include the IDs of two players, each with their individual scores and the total partnership score. For each pair, the player with the higher individual score should be listed as player 1, and the player with the lower score as player 2. In cases where both players have the same score, the player with the higher ID should be player 1, and the player with the lower ID should be player 2. There can be multiple rows for a single match.

WITH ball_data AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.match_id,
        bb.innings_no,
        bb.over_id,
        bb.ball_id,
        bb.striker,
        bb.non_striker,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) as runs_scored
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
),
-- Get cumulative score for each player
player_cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        ball_id,
        player_id,
        runs_scored,
        SUM(runs_scored) OVER (
            PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no 
            ORDER BY ball_id 
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) as cumulative_sum
    FROM (
        SELECT match_id, innings_no, ball_id, striker as player_id, runs_scored FROM ball_data
        UNION ALL
        SELECT match_id, innings_no, ball_id, non_striker as player_id, runs_scored FROM ball_data
    )
)
SELECT 
    wt.match_id,
    wt.innings_no,
    wt.ball_id,
    wt.player_out as player_out_id,
    (SELECT MAX(pc2.cumulative_sum) FROM player_cumulative pc2 
     WHERE pc2.match_id = wt.match_id 
       AND pc2.innings_no = wt.innings_no 
       AND pc2.ball_id = wt.ball_id
       AND pc2.player_id = wt.player_out
    ) as player_out_cum_score,
    (SELECT MAX(pc3.cumulative_sum) FROM player_cumulative pc3 
     WHERE pc3.match_id = wt.match_id 
       AND pc3.innings_no = wt.innings_no 
       AND pc3.ball_id = wt.ball_id
       AND pc3.player_id <> wt.player_out
    ) as partner_cum_score
FROM wicket_taken wt
WHERE wt.match_id = 335987 AND wt.innings_no = 1
ORDER BY wt.ball_id, wt.player_out
